UX_and_Security_Rule: Always show free-text input below options.

Bot_Prompt: This looks like [predicted category]. Is that right?
UX_and_Security_Rule: Do not force the predicted category.

Bot_Prompt: Which option best describes the issue?
Primary_Options: Load category-specific issue choices|Other / Not listed
UX_and_Security_Rule: Options narrow retrieval; Other opens free text.

Bot_Prompt: Ask one question at a time using Dynamic_Form_Fields.
Primary_Options: Buttons/dropdowns where finite; text/file only where necessary
UX_and_Security_Rule: Never request secrets, OTPs, passwords, recovery codes, or full personal data.

Bot_Prompt: Is anyone else affected? Is there a safety or security concern?
Primary_Options: Only me|Several users|Whole site|Unknown; plus risk-specific choices

Bot_Prompt: I found a suitable procedure. Start Attempt 1?
Primary_Options: Start|Show steps|Raise ticket instead|Talk to human

Bot_Prompt: Did the exact issue work after this step?
Primary_Options: Yes, resolved|No, same issue|Different error|Could not try it
UX_and_Security_Rule: Do not infer success from silence.

Bot_Prompt: I will hand this to support with everything already collected.
UX_and_Security_Rule: Show a user-readable summary before transfer.
